```{r}

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(glmmTMB)
library(emmeans)
library(DHARMa)
library(ggplot2)
library (tidyverse)
library (multcomp)
#install.packages("writexl")
library (writexl)
```

```{r}

# 1. Load and prepare
df_yield <- read_excel("~/Ad_Planta_Trials/Raw_data/Field trial/Total fruit_number_weight.xlsx") %>%
  rename(
    Treatment    = Treatment,
    Block        = Block,
    Plant        = Plant,
    fruit_number = `Total fruit number`,
    fruit_weight = `Total fruit weight`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = relevel(as.factor(Treatment), 
                        ref = "Non-treated control"),
    Block     = as.factor(Block),
    Plant     = as.factor(Plant)
  )
View(df_yield)

# 2. Quick summary
cat("=== Mean yield per treatment ===\n")
df_yield %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_number = round(mean(fruit_number), 1),
    sd_number   = round(sd(fruit_number), 1),
    mean_weight = round(mean(fruit_weight), 1),
    sd_weight   = round(sd(fruit_weight), 1),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_weight))

# 3. Check distributions
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(df_yield$fruit_number, main = "Fruit number", xlab = "Count")
hist(df_yield$fruit_weight, main = "Fruit weight (g)", xlab = "Weight")

# === Model 1: Fruit NUMBER ===
# Count data → Poisson or negative binomial
m_number <- glmmTMB(
  fruit_number ~ Treatment + (1|Block),
  family = nbinom2(),    # negative binomial - robust to overdispersion
  data   = df_yield
)

summary(m_number)
res_number <- simulateResiduals(m_number, n = 1000)
plot(res_number)

# === Model 2: Fruit WEIGHT ===
# Continuous positive → Gaussian 
# Fruit weight - try Gaussian instead
m_weight2 <- glmmTMB(
  fruit_weight ~ Treatment + (1|Block),
  family = gaussian(),
  data   = df_yield
)
summary(m_weight2)
res_weight2 <- simulateResiduals(m_weight2, n = 1000)
plot(res_weight2)

```
Plots
```{r}
# === Emmeans for both outcomes ===
emm_number <- emmeans(m_number, ~ Treatment, type = "response")
emm_weight <- emmeans(m_weight2, ~ Treatment, type = "response")

# Letter groupings
cld_number <- multcomp::cld(emm_number,
                             adjust  = "tukey",
                             Letters = letters,
                             alpha   = 0.05) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    .group    = trimws(.group),
    outcome   = "Fruit number",
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c(
      "Non-treated control",
      "Copper standard",
      "Cons1 (Pb39 and Pb177)",
      "Pseudathrobacter sp. Pb177",
      "Streptomyces sp. Pb39"
    ))
  )

cld_weight <- multcomp::cld(emm_weight,
                             adjust  = "tukey",
                             Letters = letters,
                             alpha   = 0.05) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    .group    = trimws(.group),
    outcome   = "Fruit weight (g)",
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c(
      "Non-treated control",
      "Copper standard",
      "Cons1 (Pb39 and Pb177)",
      "Pseudathrobacter sp. Pb177",
      "Streptomyces sp. Pb39"
    ))
  )

print(cld_number)
print(cld_weight)

# Check column names first
cat("=== cld_number columns ===\n")
names(cld_number)

cat("=== cld_weight columns ===\n")
names(cld_weight)

```
Plots

```{r}
plot_yield <- function(cld_data, y_label) {
  
  # Detect the correct y column (emmean or response)
  y_col <- ifelse("emmean" %in% names(cld_data), "emmean", "response")
  ci_low <- ifelse("lower.CL" %in% names(cld_data), "lower.CL", "asymp.LCL")
  ci_up  <- ifelse("upper.CL" %in% names(cld_data), "upper.CL", "asymp.UCL")
  
  ggplot(cld_data,
         aes(x    = Treatment,
             y    = .data[[y_col]],
             fill = Treatment)) +

    geom_col(width = 0.65, color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +

    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = .data[[ci_low]],
                      ymax = .data[[ci_up]]),
                  width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5) +

    geom_text(aes(y     = .data[[ci_up]] + max(.data[[ci_up]]) * 0.03,
                  label = .group),
              size = 4, fontface = "bold") +

    scale_fill_manual(values = trt_colors) +

    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +

    labs(x = "Treatment", y = y_label) +

    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x      = element_text(size = 12, angle = 55,
                                      vjust = 1, hjust = 1,
                                      face = "italic"),
      axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 13),
      legend.position  = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

p_number <- plot_yield(cld_number, "Total fruit number")
p_weight <- plot_yield(cld_weight, "Total fruit weight (g)")

library(patchwork)
p_number + p_weight +
  plot_annotation(
  )
ggsave(
  filename    = "yield_fruit_number_weight.tiff",
  plot        = p_number + p_weight +
                  plot_annotation(
                  ),
  path        = "~/Ad_Planta_Trials/Outputfiles/Field output files",
  width       = 12,
  height      = 6,
  dpi         = 300,
  units       = "in",
  device      = "tiff",
  compression = "lzw"
)



```
